Description

PGE2 formed in the inflamed joint binds the EP1 receptor on nociceptors. EP1 is described as coupled to Gq, whose α subunit activates phospholipase Cβ, although the cloned receptor can raise intracellular calcium by calcium entry independently of phospholipase C. In sensory neurons EP1 sensitises TRPV1 through protein kinase C and lowers its heat threshold, and mice lacking EP1 show less PGE2-induced allodynia and inflammatory heat hyperalgesia. RGS proteins end Gq signalling by accelerating GTP hydrolysis.
